messages:
incident-bot: P1 PAGE: prod-us-west-2 GPU pool exhausted; autoscaling not responding due to custom metrics pipeline failures. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/gpu-autoscale

alice (oncall): ack. Seeing steady increase in pending requests on /v1/generate-chat, tail latency > 6s, clients getting 429s and grpc CANCEL. Queue +1100 over 10m.

ben (infra): noticed prometheus-adapter returning 504s to the k8s API server. Adapter logs: 'GET /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/inference/gpu_queue_length 504 (upstream timeout)'. Prometheus TSDB iowait high around 1721009600..1721009800.

carmen (eng-sre): HPA hasn't been able to fetch metrics since ~1721009580. kubectl describe hpa gpu-workers => 'unable to get metrics: internal server error'. Current replicas: 10, desired: 10. No automatic scale.

dinesh (ml-infra): if custom metrics are blackholed the HPA will just sit. Recommend quick manual scale + route-based degradation: increase replicas to 40, divert non-enterprise traffic to small-cpu models, enable short-lived fallback HPA using resource metrics.

alice (oncall): notifying support & product for customer impact. Support: please triage any open customer pages.

support-bot: Support rotation pinged. Affected customers reported: storyflow (increased failures), syndic.ai (timeouts). Creating tickets INC-5831, INC-5832.

ben (infra): remediation attempt 1: restart prometheus-adapter to clear transient connections and enable a tiny in-process cache. Also attempting to spin up a read-only prometheus replica to offload queries.

ben (infra): commands run: 
```
kubectl -n monitoring set env deployment/prometheus-adapter QUERY_TIMEOUT=25s METRIC_CACHE_TTL=90
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter
```

carmen (eng-sre): executing manual scaling now and patching HPA minReplicas to prevent immediate downscale once things settle. Also pushing an edge rule to reduce concurrency for free-tier to buy time.

alice (oncall): manual scale command: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-worker --replicas=40
kubectl -n inference patch hpa gpu-worker -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":14}}'
```
Scale accepted. New pods creating; some pods Pending due to image pull rate limiting — pulling from secondary registry mirror.

dinesh (ml-infra): deployed routing override: non-enterprise 30% -> small-cpu-service. Also applied short-lived fallback HPA (metrics-server cpu-based) to allow conservative autoscaling while custom metrics recover.

ben (infra): discovered storage compaction job on Prometheus node saturated IO at 1721009500. Cloud storage throttled compaction and we've paused heavy retention tasks. After adapter restart error rates dropped significantly.

alice (oncall): applied emergency edge rate-limit: free-tier concurrency -> 2, burst 4. That reduced influx and allowed queue to stabilize.

carmen (eng-sre): monitoring update: queue peaked then started decreasing ~8m after manual scale and routing change. GPU pod utilization down from 94% -> 68%. HPA custom metrics now returning values intermittently; adapter 5xx rate dropped below alert threshold.

ben (infra): enabling short-term cached responses in adapter for the gpu_queue_length metric (TTL 90s) to reduce load on Prometheus while we fix storage scheduling. Also adding alert 'prometheus-adapter 5xx > 1% for 5m' to catch regressions earlier.

dinesh (ml-infra): we're draining some long-lived KV cache sessions to free GPU memory and speed up new pod starts; that freed ~10% working set and shortened pod startup time.

alice (oncall): handing over to ben (infra) for post-incident follow-up and cloud vendor escalation. I'll draft customer-facing update and include estimated impact window.

ben (infra): taking over. Collecting logs, timeline, and opening cloud support case for Prometheus storage scheduling. Postmortem owners: carmen + dinesh + ben. Deliverable: root-cause analysis + remediation plan in 72 hours.

carmen (eng-sre): post-incident actions proposed: add a cached proxy for custom metrics with circuit breaker, implement multi-source HPA strategy (custom metrics -> resource metrics fallback), avoid heavy retention/compaction during peak hours by scheduling maintenance windows, document manual scale playbook including registry mirror steps.

incident-bot: Incident P1 marked RESOLVED by carmen (eng-sre) at 1721012450. Follow-ups: postmortem, customer communications, adapter hardening, HPA fallback design.

alice (oncall): notes for postmortem: timeline, commands executed, customer tickets created (INC-5831, INC-5832), mitigation effectiveness metrics (queue drop time, peak util, pods added). Assigning action items and ETA in the postmortem doc.

carmen (eng-sre): closing live mitigation thread. Will keep the channel open for follow-up questions. Postmortem draft due in 72h. :memo:
